exposure: type of placenta previa (major vs. minor)
antenatal ultrasound diagnosis of placenta previa
cohort: The study population consisted of all women with the antenatal ultrasound diagnosis of placenta previa during delivery at Helsinki University Hospital.
finding: The existing screening protocol for placenta previa missed almost one fifth of cases, and women with major placenta previa had significantly more blood loss and delivered earlier than women with minor placenta previa.
